research_mode: official ONS and Home Office sources only; outcome cohort and closed-period semantics, timeliness and Crimsec4 limits, open-data schema and revision states, geography editions and current outcome snapshots; no parcel result or safety score claimed

sources.name: Appendix-table planned revision from new data
verified_claims: ONS says initial estimates may be revised as further data become available
such revisions are expected for some statistics
previous versions are retained on the dataset page
limitations: initial estimates must not be treated as immutable
revision status is measure-specific

sources.name: Appendix-table method or system revision
verified_claims: ONS says revisions can result from changes to methods
revisions can also result from system changes
these are distinct from routine arrival of further data
limitations: method and system revisions can alter historical comparability
the reason for update must be retained

sources.name: Planned revision and error distinction
verified_claims: ONS distinguishes planned revisions from genuine mistakes
the two update types have different meanings
superseded files remain identified
limitations: a changed number is not automatically an error
revision provenance must be read before correction logic

sources.name: Official-statistics correction communication
verified_claims: ONS says genuine mistakes occur rarely
when they occur corrections are made in a timely manner
corrections are announced and explained to users
limitations: absence of an announcement is not proof that a value is final
correction evidence must be edition-specific

sources.name: CSEW pandemic collection interruption
verified_claims: face-to-face CSEW collection was suspended on 17 March 2020
the suspension was caused by the coronavirus pandemic
the interruption affects the survey-series production context
limitations: pandemic-period estimates require collection-mode metadata
the suspension date is not a crime-trend breakpoint by itself

sources.name: TCSEW inclusion period
verified_claims: tables from year ending June 2020 to year ending March 2022 include Telephone-operated CSEW data
TCSEW followed the face-to-face suspension
the collection mode differs from standard CSEW
limitations: TCSEW and face-to-face estimates need mode-aware comparison
the stated range is a table-production period

sources.name: Formal and informal sanction outcome groups
verified_claims: charged or summonsed is outcome 1
taken into consideration is outcome 4
formal out-of-court outcomes include 2 3 and 6 while informal out-of-court outcomes include 7 and 8
limitations: group labels are not an ordinal performance scale
outcome definitions can change by framework edition

sources.name: Year-ending March 2026 no-suspect snapshot
verified_claims: the release reports 22.8 percent of cases closed because no suspect was identified
the previous-year comparison shown is 22.3 percent
the figure is a snapshot at the time of analysis
limitations: the percentage is not a parcel-level risk measure
later outcome maturation can change snapshots

sources.name: Year-ending March 2026 open-investigation snapshot
verified_claims: the release reports 9.5 percent of offences not yet assigned an outcome
the previous-year comparison shown is 10.9 percent
the measure is based on current case status at analysis time
limitations: open-investigation shares are cohort-age sensitive
the percentage is not a final resolution rate

sources.name: Year-ending March 2026 evidential-difficulty snapshot
verified_claims: the release reports 35.6 percent of offences closed due to evidential difficulties
the previous-year comparison shown is 37.2 percent
the category aggregates multiple evidential-difficulty pathways
limitations: the aggregate does not identify local causal conditions
the percentage must not be converted into a safety score
